# Data Quality Audit: Hallucinated/Mis-sourced Dates in Generated Use Cases

**Date of audit:** 2026-06-25
**Scope:** 6 `UseCase` records generated by `StructuredReportGenerator` on 2026-06-25, across themes `ENDOSCOPE-CLEANING-IMPACTS` (id 25) and `KHAMSIN-IMPACTS` (id 27), all relating to the Aston University / PFE Medical "Khamsin" automated endoscope cleaner KTP project.
**Outcome:** All 6 records below were deleted from the database after this report was saved, as part of cleaning up extraction errors caused by a prompt bug (see Root Cause).

## Root cause (already fixed)

The extraction prompt's schema description for `use_case_date` embedded the literal current date as text and demanded a full `YYYY-MM-DD` value with no allowance for partial precision. This caused the model to (a) echo back "today" when it had no real date, and (b) pad incomplete dates with a fabricated day (usually `-01`). Fixed in:
- `backend/core/llm/langchain/langgraph/report_generator_utils.py` (schema wording)
- `backend/core/llm/langchain/langgraph/structured_report_generator.py` (added a code-level `_sanitize_use_case_date` guard)
- `backend/core/llm/langchain/langgraph/prompts.py` (credibility check now explicitly verifies the claimed date against the article's actual date evidence)

## Records removed

| ID | Theme | Company | Claimed `use_case_date` | Credibility / Relevance (self-scored) | Cited source | Finding |
|----|-------|---------|--------------------------|----------------------------------------|--------------|---------|
| 319 | ENDOSCOPE-CLEANING-IMPACTS | University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust | **2026-04-23** | 9/10, 9/10 | [aston.ac.uk article](https://www.aston.ac.uk/latest-news/aston-university-experts-team-medical-products-company-help-make-endoscopes-cleaner-and) | Article is actually dated **20 May 2024** — claimed date is wrong by ~2 years. The article also never mentions UHB Trust, "140,000 procedures," or a "1000x" reduction figure; those claims aren't supported by this source at all. |
| 321 | KHAMSIN-IMPACTS | University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust | **2023-06-01** | 8/10, 6/10 | [decontaminationandsterilisation.co.uk](https://www.decontaminationandsterilisation.co.uk/khamsin-the-worlds-first-fully-automated-endoscope-cleaner) | Source is a real, general Khamsin article but never mentions Trust-wide adoption or Solihull Hospital. The real "full NHS Trust adoption" event it's describing actually happened **25 Sept 2025** (confirmed via a separate, correctly-dated record). Date and source attribution are both wrong for this specific claim. |
| 326 | KHAMSIN-IMPACTS | University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust | 2025-08-29 | 8/10, 8/10 | [CQC well-led report](https://www.cqc.org.uk/provider/RRK/reports/AP9848/well-led-assessment/well-led) | The date itself matches this CQC report's real publication date — but the report is a governance/leadership assessment that **never mentions Khamsin, Solihull Hospital's Endoscopy Unit, or "140,000 procedures" anywhere**. A real, correctly-dated source was cited for a claim it doesn't contain. |
| 330 | ENDOSCOPE-CLEANING-IMPACTS | PFE Medical + University Hospitals Birmingham | **2023-05-01** | 8/10, 9/10 | [staffsbizawards.co.uk](https://www.staffsbizawards.co.uk/innovation-award-2023) | Independently confirmed reporting puts this award in **Aug 2023**, not May. The record also conflates statistics and dates from at least two unrelated source periods (the Nov 2022 trial results and the Aug 2023 award) into a single claim. |
| 333 | KHAMSIN-IMPACTS | University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust | **2018-01-01** | 7/10, 9/10 | [ScienceDirect / J. Hospital Infection paper](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0195670126000952) | The cited paper is the same **June 2026** lab antimicrobial-materials study confirmed elsewhere (PMID 41864436) — the claimed date is wrong by **8 years**. The "sustained impact since 2018, 140,000 procedures" deployment narrative is not supported by what is actually a bench/lab study, not a clinical deployment record. |
| 335 | ENDOSCOPE-CLEANING-IMPACTS | NHS Trusts | **2023-01-01** | 8/10, 9/10 | [aston.ac.uk article](https://www.aston.ac.uk/latest-news/pfe-medical-wins-business-award-product-developed-through-aston-university-knowledge) | Article is actually dated **21 Aug 2023** — claimed date is wrong by ~8 months. The article only names Good Hope Hospital as an adopter; the record overgeneralises this to plural "NHS Trusts." The "140,000 procedures" figure isn't in this source either. |

Note: all six have a `-01` day or a defaulted day component except 319 and 326, which is the other half of the same prompt bug (forcing a full day when the source only gave a month/year, or none at all).
